subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the final rebased SHA be approved as one grouped update for the credentialed and security-sensitive GitHub Actions workflows?
rationale: The patch has no identified code defect, but selecting executable third-party revisions for token creation, publishing, scanning, and Codex agent jobs is a repository trust decision that automated tests cannot authorize.

options.title: Rebase and approve together
options.body: Review the final immutable pins and sensitive workflow checks, then accept the grouped same-major update as one coordinated automation change.

options.title: Split credentialed actions
options.body: Separate token, publishing, and Codex action revisions from routine setup-action updates to reduce the security-review blast radius.

recommendation.title: Rebase and approve together
recommendation.body: Review the final immutable pins and sensitive workflow checks, then accept the grouped same-major update as one coordinated automation change.

likelyOwner.reason: The workflow history shows the broadest recent ownership of action-runtime modernization and the affected agent and release automation.
